chunks: Al-Shaykh, may Allah the Exalted support him, informed me from Abū al-Qāsim Jaʿfar ibn Muḥammad, from Muḥammad ibn Yaʿqūb, from a number of our companions, from Sahl ibn Ziyād, from Muḥammad ibn Sinān, from Muḥammad ibn ʿAjlān, from Abī ʿAbdillāh عليه السلام, who said:

“Draw him out gently. Then when you place him in his niche, let the one most entitled among the people to him stand at the side of his head, so that he may mention the Name of Allah, send blessings upon the Prophet صلى الله عليه وآله وسلم, seek refuge from the accursed Shayṭān, and recite the Opening of the Book and the two refuge-seeking surahs.”

And Āyat al-Kursī. And if he is able to uncover his cheek and place it against the earth, he should do so. And he should recite the shahādah and mention whatever he knows until he comes to his companion.”

Al-Shaykh, may Allah the Exalted support him, said: It is recommended to prompt him with the two testimonies and the names of the Imams عليهم السلام when placing him in the grave, before arranging the bricks over him, saying: O so-and-so son of so-and-so. And he mentioned the manner of the talqīn.

key_terms.آيَةَ الْكُرْسِيِّ: the Throne Verse, recited as part of burial rites
key_terms.اسْمَ اللَّهِ: the Name of Allah, invoked at the time of burial
key_terms.التَّلْقِينِ: the prompting of beliefs and testimonies to the deceased in the grave
key_terms.الشَّهَادَتَيْنِ: the two testimonies of faith to be prompted to the deceased
key_terms.الْأَئِمَّةِ: the Imams عليهم السلام whose names are included in the talqīn
key_terms.الْمُعَوِّذَتَيْنِ: the two surahs of seeking refuge, Sūrat al-Falaq and Sūrat al-Nās
key_terms.فَاتِحَةَ الْكِتَابِ: Sūrat al-Fātiḥah, recited at the grave
key_terms.لَحْدِهِ: his grave-niche, the side cavity in the grave where the deceased is placed

ai.seo_question: What is recommended to recite and do when placing a deceased person in the grave according to Shia hadith?
ai.summary: This hadith describes recommended acts when placing the deceased into the grave, including gentle handling, recitation of Qur'anic passages, remembrance of Allah, salawat upon the Prophet صلى الله عليه وآله وسلم, and seeking refuge from Shayṭān. It also states the recommended practice of talqīn, prompting the deceased with the shahādatayn and the names of the Imams عليهم السلام before sealing the grave.
